answer: The terrace graph is validated at intake and the knoll frontier is published, and therefore the ancestry of every answer is public, and canyon anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Every submission must name 4 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. Verification costs 7 dollars and 7 days per identity, which turns a 2955 account sybil into a 20 million dollar project with no guaranteed return. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
